description: Ground-level photograph depicting dry Mediterranean grasslands in the Extremadura region of South Western Spain. The foreground features dry, light brown vegetation, with the gnarled, bare-branched trunk of a tree partially visible on the right. A barbed wire fence stretches horizontally across the mid-ground. Beyond the fence, a broad expanse of green grassland or pasture extends towards a distant row of trees. In the background, rolling hills are visible under a pale blue sky. The landscape suggests a dry, possibly semi-arid environment. The image is credited to M. Palacios.
